Risk Statement: Airtable 5 req/sec API rate limit breach during peak batch synchronization
Mitigation Strategy: Engineered token-bucket leaky queue with exponential backoff and jitter; batching mutations into 10-record chunks.

Risk Statement: Webhook 7-day expiration causing dropped event notifications
Mitigation Strategy: Scheduled automatic heartbeat cron job calling /refresh endpoint every 3 days.

Risk Statement: Schema drift between local DDL code and live Airtable base
Mitigation Strategy: Integrated airtable-toolkit schema:export and CI/CD validation steps to catch uncommitted schema changes.

Risk Statement: Attachment storage exhaustion on high-volume document ingestion
Mitigation Strategy: Enterprise trial allocation provides 20GB-1000GB; automated offloading to S3 cold storage after 90 days.
